entries.en: Two coils of sisal hemp lay beside the unfinished chair.
entries.zh: 两卷剑麻纤维放在那把尚未完工的椅子旁。

entries.en: The diver's close-up captured a skeleton shrimp clinging to a strand of seaweed.
entries.zh: 潜水员的特写拍到一只抓着一缕海藻的麦秆虫。

entries.en: He scraped the excess ski wax from the base before packing his skis.
entries.zh: 他收起滑雪板前，刮掉了板底多余的雪蜡。

entries.en: The crew lowered the skipjack tuna onto the weighing platform.
entries.zh: 船员把那条鲣鱼放到了称重台上。

entries.en: A fallen branch lay across the skunk cabbage I was trying to photograph.
entries.zh: 一根落枝横在我想拍摄的那株臭菘上。

entries.en: A slave ant carried a crumb past the observer's pencil.
entries.zh: 一只奴蚁搬着碎屑，从观察者的铅笔旁经过。

entries.en: The student adjusted her lens as a slave-making ant crossed the stone.
entries.zh: 一只悍蚁爬过石头时，那名学生调整了镜头。

entries.en: Our lead sled dog waited quietly while I untangled the harness.
entries.zh: 我解开缠绕的挽具时，领头的雪橇狗安静地等着。

entries.en: She tied a loose ribbon around the slender wheatgrass before measuring its height.
entries.zh: 她量那株细茎冰草的高度前，先在上面松松地系了根丝带。

entries.en: The researcher examined the slime bacteria under a different microscope.
entries.zh: 研究员换了一台显微镜来观察那些粘细菌。

entries.en: A patch of slime mold caught her attention on the fallen log.
entries.zh: 倒下的原木上有一片黏液菌，引起了她的注意。

entries.en: We returned with a tripod to photograph the slime mould more clearly.
entries.zh: 我们带着三脚架回来，想把那些粘菌拍得更清楚。

entries.en: A slippery dick swam across the lower corner of the diver's video.
entries.zh: 一条隆头鱼游过了潜水员所拍视频的下方角落。

entries.en: The sloth bear watched the keeper replace its water.
entries.zh: 那只长毛熊看着饲养员给它换水。

entries.en: A small white landed on the gardener's glove as she reached for her shears.
entries.zh: 园丁伸手拿剪刀时，一只菜粉蝶落在了她的手套上。

entries.en: The new fence leaves plenty of room for our smoke tree.
entries.zh: 新围栏为我家的黄栌留出了充足的空间。

entries.en: The technician placed the smut fungus sample in a separate container.
entries.zh: 技术员把黑粉菌样本放进了另一个容器。

entries.en: The camera lost sight of the snail darter beneath the rippling surface.
entries.zh: 相机拍不到波光下的那条螺镖鲈了。

entries.en: The snake mackerel was photographed beside a ruler before the examination.
entries.zh: 检查前，那条蛇鲭鱼被放在尺子旁拍了照。

entries.en: I moved the snake plant to make room for the parcel.
entries.zh: 我挪开虎尾兰，腾出地方放包裹。

entries.en: A snapping beetle startled me when it flipped off the bench.
entries.zh: 一只磕头虫从长凳上弹起，把我吓了一跳。

entries.en: The snapping shrimp retreated behind a rock as the camera approached.
entries.zh: 相机靠近时，那只鼓虾退到了石头后面。

entries.en: She found a snout beetle on the folded corner of her picnic blanket.
entries.zh: 她在野餐毯折起的一角发现了一只象鼻虫。

entries.en: The snow bunting vanished from the frame just as I pressed the shutter.
entries.zh: 我刚按下快门，那只雪鹀就离开了画面。

entries.en: We watched a snow goose glide across the water past the empty rowing boat.
entries.zh: 我们看着一只雪雁从空着的划艇旁游过。

entries.en: The keeper paused until the snow leopard had entered the other enclosure.
entries.zh: 饲养员等到那只雪豹进入另一处围栏区域后才继续行动。

entries.en: The gardener set a chair beneath the snowdrop tree.
entries.zh: 园丁在银钟树下放了一把椅子。

entries.en: The snowshoe hare paused at the edge of the photographer's frame.
entries.zh: 那只北美野兔在摄影师的画面边缘停了下来。

entries.en: A snowy egret walked behind us while we were folding the tripod.
entries.zh: 我们折起三脚架时，一只雪鹭从身后走过。

entries.en: She observed each social insect for ten minutes before moving to the next colony.
entries.zh: 她对每只社会性昆虫都观察十分钟，然后再去观察下一个群体。

entries.en: The sodium sulphate arrived in a sealed container with the other laboratory supplies.
entries.zh: 硫酸钠装在密封容器里，与其他实验室用品一起送到了。

entries.en: The glassblower set aside the soft glass for a smaller project.
entries.zh: 玻璃吹制工把软质玻璃留给了另一个规模较小的制作项目。

entries.en: He cut a short length of soft solder before heating the joint.
entries.zh: 他加热接头前，先剪下了一小段软焊料。

entries.en: The mill kept the soft wheat in a separate storage bin.
entries.zh: 磨坊把软质小麦存放在单独的粮仓里。

entries.en: A soft-shelled turtle surfaced beside the floating camera.
entries.zh: 一只鳖在漂浮的相机旁露出了水面。

entries.en: A little soluble glass had leaked onto the workshop floor.
entries.zh: 少量水玻璃漏到了车间地板上。

entries.en: The song sparrow remained on the fence while we carried the ladder past.
entries.zh: 我们抬着梯子经过时，那只北美歌雀仍停在围栏上。

entries.en: They shifted the path to avoid damaging the sorrel tree's roots.
entries.zh: 他们改了小路的走向，以免损伤那棵酸木的根。

entries.en: She brushed the soil from the sour dock before laying it beside her notebook.
entries.zh: 她掸去酸模上的泥土，才把它放在笔记本旁。

entries.en: A patch of sour grass had grown through the broken fence.
entries.zh: 一片酸模从破损的围栏间长了出来。

entries.en: The southern cypress stood between the visitor centre and the pond.
entries.zh: 那棵落羽松长在游客中心与池塘之间。

entries.en: We found the missing ball under the southern magnolia.
entries.zh: 我们在广玉兰下找到了丢失的球。

entries.en: The surveyor stepped back to include the entire southern yellow pine in her photograph.
entries.zh: 测量员后退了几步，把整棵美国长叶松拍进照片。

entries.en: A sow bug crawled out from beneath the overturned flowerpot.
entries.zh: 一只鼠妇从翻倒的花盆底下爬了出来。

entries.en: The spadefoot toad sat motionless beside the photographer's equipment case.
entries.zh: 那只锄足蟾一动不动地待在摄影师的器材箱旁。

entries.en: A sparrow hawk passed above us while we waited by the gate.
entries.zh: 我们在门旁等候时，一只食雀鹰从头顶飞过。

entries.en: He marked the spear thistle with a stake before mowing the verge.
entries.zh: 他修剪路边草地前，先在那株矛叶蓟旁插了根标桩。

entries.en: A sphinx moth hovered outside the open kitchen window.
entries.zh: 一只天蛾在敞开的厨房窗外悬飞。

entries.en: The spider crab moved out of view before the diver could focus.
entries.zh: 潜水员还没来得及对焦，那只蜘蛛蟹就离开了视野。

entries.en: She adjusted the magnifying lens until the spider mite came into focus.
entries.zh: 她调整放大镜，直到能清楚地看到那只叶螨。

entries.en: The spider monkey reached for the rope hanging beside its platform.
entries.zh: 那只蛛猴伸手去抓平台旁垂下的绳子。

entries.en: A spider plant hangs above the desk where I answer letters.
entries.zh: 一盆吊兰挂在我回信的书桌上方。

entries.en: She lifted the spike lavender out of its cracked pot.
entries.zh: 她把那株宽叶熏衣草从裂开的花盆里取了出来。

entries.en: The soap maker weighed the spike lavender oil in a small glass dish.
entries.zh: 制皂师用一个小玻璃皿称量穗熏衣草油。

entries.en: The cap of the spike oil bottle had rolled beneath the cabinet.
entries.zh: 装穗花油的瓶子的瓶盖滚到了柜子底下。

entries.en: The jeweller placed the spinel ruby on a square of black velvet.
entries.zh: 珠宝商把那颗红尖晶石放在一块方形黑丝绒上。

entries.en: The spiny anteater disappeared behind a log in the enclosure.
entries.zh: 那只针鼹消失在围栏区域里的一根原木后面。

entries.en: The crew photographed the spiny dogfish before recording its length.
entries.zh: 船员拍下那条白斑角鲨后，记录了它的体长。

entries.en: A spiny lizard crossed the stone step in front of my camera.
entries.zh: 一只刺蜥属蜥蜴从我的相机前爬过石阶。

entries.meaningZh: 粘假发用快干胶水〔舞台用品〕
entries.en: The actor opened the spirit gum while the dresser trimmed his false moustache.
entries.zh: 服装师修剪他的假胡须时，那名演员打开了粘假发用的快干胶水。

entries.en: The painter put the spirit of turpentine in the locked materials cupboard.
entries.zh: 画家把松节油放进了上锁的材料柜。

entries.en: The laboratory assistant checked the seal on the spirits of ammonia bottle.
entries.zh: 实验室助理检查了氨酊瓶的密封情况。

entries.en: The restorer found a sealed bottle of spirits of wine in the old workshop.
entries.zh: 修复师在旧工坊里发现了一瓶密封的酒精。

entries.en: The veterinary student located the splint bone on the horse skeleton.
entries.zh: 兽医专业学生在马的骨架上找到了赘骨。

entries.en: A sponge gourd hung through a gap in the trellis.
entries.zh: 一根丝瓜从棚架的空隙中垂了下来。

entries.en: She rotated the specimen until the spore case faced the lens.
entries.zh: 她转动标本，让孢子囊朝向镜头。

entries.en: The spore mother cell was visible near the centre of the microscope image.
entries.zh: 显微镜图像的中央附近可以看到一个孢子母细胞。

entries.en: The student drew the spore sac before increasing the magnification.
entries.zh: 那名学生画下孢子囊后，才调高放大倍数。

entries.en: He released the sport fish after his friend took a photograph.
entries.zh: 朋友拍完照后，他把那条供垂钓娱乐的鱼放了回去。

entries.en: The sporting dog waited beside its handler while the van was unloaded.
entries.zh: 厢式货车卸货时，那只猎狗等在训犬员身旁。

entries.en: The spotted crake appeared briefly between two clumps of reeds.
entries.zh: 那只斑胸田鸡在两丛芦苇间短暂地露了面。

entries.en: A spotted flycatcher settled on the branch directly above our bench.
entries.zh: 一只斑鹟落在了长凳正上方的树枝上。

entries.en: The arborist measured the spotted gum before planning the new walkway.
entries.zh: 树木养护师先测量了那棵斑桉，再规划新的步道。

entries.en: The spotted owl turned its head as the camera clicked.
entries.zh: 相机咔嗒一响，那只斑点猫头鹰便转过头来。

entries.en: We stopped walking when a spotted sandpiper crossed the path ahead.
entries.zh: 一只斑鹬穿过前方的小路时，我们停下了脚步。

entries.en: The gardener protected the spring beauty with a small wire frame.
entries.zh: 园丁用一个小铁丝框护住了那株春美草属植物。

entries.en: The maintenance crew examined the spring frog before reopening the track.
entries.zh: 维修人员检查了弹性辙叉后，才重新开放铁路线。

entries.en: The spring vetch covered the corner where we had left the wheelbarrow.
entries.zh: 我们原先放独轮车的角落长满了箭舌豌豆。

entries.en: A springer spaniel brought the muddy tennis ball back to me.
entries.zh: 一只斯伯林格斯班尼犬把沾满泥的网球叼回给了我。

entries.en: The gardener moved the sign away from the spruce pine's trunk.
entries.zh: 园丁把标牌从那棵光松的树干旁移开了。

entries.en: The mare became restless when her stable companion left for the show.
entries.zh: 同厩的另一匹马离开去参加展会后，那匹母马变得焦躁起来。

entries.en: The laboratory repeated the measurement of stable factor activity in the stored sample.
entries.zh: 实验室重新测量了所保存样本中稳定因子的活性。

entries.en: The stag beetle gripped the twig while she moved it off the path.
entries.zh: 她把那只锹虫移离小路时，它紧抓着小树枝。

entries.en: He lifted the staghorn fern from its hook before repairing the wall.
entries.zh: 他修墙前，先把鹿角蕨从挂钩上取了下来。

entries.en: The hydraulic stake driver remained on the trailer overnight.
entries.zh: 那台液压打桩机在拖车上放了一夜。

entries.en: Our standard schnauzer fell asleep beside the suitcase I was packing.
entries.zh: 我收拾行李箱时，我家的标准型雪纳瑞犬在旁边睡着了。

entries.en: The technician separated a handful of staple fibre from the tangled sample.
entries.zh: 技术员从缠结的样本中分出了一把定长短纤维。

entries.en: The gardener checked the supports around the young star apple.
entries.zh: 园丁检查了那株金星果幼树周围的支撑物。

entries.en: The star jasmine had climbed beyond the frame we installed last year.
entries.zh: 络石已经攀出了我们去年安装的架子。

entries.en: She sketched the star magnolia from the bench by the entrance.
entries.zh: 她坐在入口旁的长凳上，画了那株星花木兰。

entries.en: The star sapphire slipped from the cloth onto the padded tray.
entries.zh: 那颗星彩蓝宝石从布上滑到了垫着软衬的托盘里。

entries.en: The cooper sorted the stave wood before beginning the new barrel.
entries.zh: 桶匠开始制作新桶前，先把桶板材分了类。

entries.en: Rain had soaked the uncovered pile of steam coal.
entries.zh: 雨水浸湿了那堆没有遮盖的锅炉用煤。

entries.en: She chose steel gray for the doors and cream for the window frames.
entries.zh: 她为门选了铁灰色，为窗框选了奶油色。

entries.en: The designer rejected steel grey after seeing it beside the tiles.
entries.zh: 设计师看到青灰色与瓷砖并排的效果后，否决了这种颜色。

entries.en: The gardener left the stem lettuce in a basket beside the sink.
entries.zh: 园丁把茎用莴苣放在水槽旁的篮子里。

entries.en: The technician transferred the sterculia gum to a clean weighing dish.
entries.zh: 技术员把刺梧桐树胶移到了干净的称量皿里。

entries.en: The bracelet was made from sterling silver left over from an earlier commission.
entries.zh: 这只手镯用的是上次订制活剩下的标准纯银。

entries.en: The worker weighed the stick lac before placing it in a storage sack.
entries.zh: 工人称过树枝虫胶后，把它装进了储存袋。

entries.en: In the final chapter, the deceitful prince comes to a sticky end.
entries.zh: 在最后一章，那个满口谎言的王子落得了可悲的下场。

entries.en: The botanist focused the camera on a stinging hair at the leaf's edge.
entries.zh: 植物学家把镜头对准了叶缘的一根螫毛。

entries.en: A stinging nettle was growing beside the broken watering can.
entries.zh: 破损的浇水壶旁长着一株大荨麻。

entries.en: She placed the stinking goosefoot specimen beside her field notebook.
entries.zh: 她把臭藜标本放在了野外记录本旁。

entries.en: The stone bass swam slowly past the underwater camera.
entries.zh: 那条多锯鲷缓缓游过水下相机。

entries.en: The stone curlew remained visible until the photographer lowered her binoculars.
entries.zh: 直到摄影师放下双筒望远镜时，那只欧石鸻仍在视野里。

entries.en: A stone fly settled on the empty tackle box.
entries.zh: 一只石蝇落在了空渔具盒上。

entries.en: The vendor packed the stone fruit separately from the delicate berries.
entries.zh: 摊贩把核果与那些娇嫩的浆果分开包装。

entries.en: The stone marten darted behind the crate before I could lift my camera.
entries.zh: 我还没来得及举起相机，那只石貂就窜到了箱子后面。

entries.en: The diver kept the measuring frame clear of the stony coral.
entries.zh: 潜水员让测量框避开了石珊瑚。

entries.en: A storm petrel passed through the beam of the boat's light.
entries.zh: 一只小海燕从船灯的光束中飞过。

entries.en: We watched the stormy petrel from the sheltered side of the deck.
entries.zh: 我们从甲板避风的一侧观察那只海燕。

entries.en: They placed the picnic bench well away from the strangler fig.
entries.zh: 他们把野餐长凳放在了远离绞杀榕的地方。

entries.en: The cook placed one straw mushroom on each of the small plates.
entries.zh: 厨师在每个小盘子里各放了一颗草菇。

entries.en: The strawberry saxifrage was still in the pot my neighbour had lent me.
entries.zh: 那株虎耳草仍种在邻居借给我的花盆里。

entries.meaningZh: 链球菌溶血素〔微生物学〕
entries.en: The laboratory compared the streptolysin measurements from the two batches.
entries.zh: 实验室对比了两个批次的链球菌溶血素测量结果。

entries.en: The striped maple cast a shadow over the empty noticeboard.
entries.zh: 那棵宾州槭的影子落在空着的布告板上。

entries.en: The striped marlin appeared in only three frames of the underwater footage.
entries.zh: 那条箕作枪鱼只出现在水下录像的三帧画面中。

entries.en: A striped skunk crossed the driveway after the last car had left.
entries.zh: 最后一辆车离开后，一只缟臭鼬穿过了车道。

entries.en: The structural iron arrived before the crane was ready to unload it.
entries.zh: 结构用铁送到时，起重机还没准备好卸货。

entries.en: A drop of substantive dye had stained the technician's sleeve.
entries.zh: 一滴直接染料染污了技术员的袖子。

entries.en: The chef set the roasted sucking pig in the centre of the table.
entries.zh: 厨师把烤乳猪放在了桌子中央。

entries.en: The storm flattened a row of sugar corn behind the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 暴风雨压倒了温室后面的一排甜玉米。

entries.en: The old sugar maple appears in every photograph of the farmhouse.
entries.zh: 那棵老糖枫出现在农舍的每张照片中。

entries.en: She carried the bundle of sugar sorghum to the weighing shed.
entries.zh: 她把那捆甜高粱搬到了称重棚。

entries.en: The inspectors sealed the room after tests detected sulfur mustard.
entries.zh: 检测发现硫芥子气后，检查人员封闭了那个房间。

entries.en: A trace of sulfur oxide remained in the gas sample.
entries.zh: 气体样本中仍有微量氧化硫。

entries.en: The sulphonic acid container had a damaged cap.
entries.zh: 装磺酸的容器盖子损坏了。

entries.en: The biologist compared the sulphur bacteria in the two samples.
entries.zh: 生物学家对比了两个样本中的硫磺细菌。

entries.en: The new monitor detected sulphur dioxide near the factory gate.
entries.zh: 新监测仪在工厂大门附近检测到了二氧化硫。

entries.en: The utility recorded a small loss of sulphur hexafluoride during the inspection.
entries.zh: 电力公司在检查期间记录到了少量六氟化硫的流失。

entries.en: The summer flounder lay beside the measuring board while the camera was adjusted.
entries.zh: 调整相机时，那条鲽鱼放在测量板旁。

entries.en: The summer tanager flew past the window before breakfast was ready.
entries.zh: 早餐还没准备好，那只玫红比蓝雀就从窗前飞过。

entries.en: She moved the sun plant away from the new awning's shade.
entries.zh: 她把那株喜阳植物从新遮篷的阴影里移了出来。

entries.en: The gardener photographed the sun spurge before clearing the neglected bed.
entries.zh: 园丁清理那片疏于打理的花坛前，先拍下了那株泽漆。

entries.en: The workers stored the surface soil beside the excavation.
entries.zh: 工人们把表土存放在了挖掘处旁边。

entries.en: The laboratory tested a different surface-active agent in the second batch.
entries.zh: 实验室在第二批试验中测试了另一种表面活性剂。

entries.en: The swamp blueberry still had its nursery tag attached.
entries.zh: 那株伞房花越桔还挂着苗圃的标签。

entries.en: They adjusted the survey line to pass beyond the swamp chestnut oak.
entries.zh: 他们调整了测量线，让它从那棵沼生栎外侧经过。

entries.en: A broken swing hung from the swamp cottonwood behind the cabin.
entries.zh: 小屋后面的池杨上挂着一副损坏的秋千。

entries.en: The photographer waited for the boat to pass behind the swamp cypress.
entries.zh: 摄影师等着船从那棵落羽杉后方驶过。

entries.en: The arborist examined the swamp gum after the branch fell.
entries.zh: 树枝掉落后，树木养护师检查了那棵卵叶桉。

entries.en: The student carried the swamp plant sample back to the field station.
entries.zh: 那名学生把沼泽植物样本带回了野外工作站。

entries.en: A swamp sparrow hopped onto the gate while we folded our map.
entries.zh: 我们折地图时，一只沼泽带鹀跳到了门上。

entries.en: The children left their bicycles under the swamp white oak.
entries.zh: 孩子们把自行车停在了二色栎下。

entries.en: The swan orchid arrived in a box lined with crumpled paper.
entries.zh: 那株天鹅兰装在一个衬着揉皱纸张的盒子里送到了。

entries.en: The gardener pruned the sweet acacia away from the narrow entrance.
entries.zh: 园丁修剪了金合欢，让它不再挡着狭窄的入口。

entries.en: She planted sweet alyssum around the base of the old fountain.
entries.zh: 她在旧喷泉的基座周围种了香雪球。

entries.en: The sweet bay was the last tree they photographed before the rain.
entries.zh: 下雨前，他们拍摄的最后一棵树是弗吉尼亚木兰。

entries.en: The researcher tied a numbered ribbon to the sweet cassava plant.
entries.zh: 研究员在那株甜木薯上系了一根带编号的丝带。

entries.en: The sweet chestnut shaded the end of the gardener's workbench.
entries.zh: 甜栗树为园丁工作台的一端遮住了阳光。

entries.en: A patch of sweet clover remained between the two mown paths.
entries.zh: 两条修剪过的小路之间还留着一片草木樨。

entries.en: The sweet fern brushed against the legs of the bench.
entries.zh: 香蕨木的枝叶轻擦着长凳的凳腿。

entries.en: The sweet gum stood beside the shed where we kept the canoe.
entries.zh: 那棵香枫长在我们存放独木舟的棚屋旁。

entries.en: A sweet potato vine trailed over the edge of the planter.
entries.zh: 一条甘薯藤从种植箱边缘垂了下来。

entries.en: She added a stem of sweet scabious to the half-finished bouquet.
entries.zh: 她往那束尚未扎好的花里添了一枝轮锋菊。

entries.en: He moved the camera so that the sweet sorghum filled the foreground.
entries.zh: 他挪了相机，让甜高粱占满前景。

entries.en: A sweet violet grew in the narrow gap beside the garden steps.
entries.zh: 花园台阶旁的狭窄缝隙里长着一株香堇菜。

entries.en: The photograph showed a sweet-potato whitefly on the underside of the leaf.
entries.zh: 照片拍到叶片背面的一只棉粉虱。

entries.en: The student identified the swim bladder on the preserved specimen.
entries.zh: 那名学生在保存的标本上辨认出了鱼鳔。

entries.en: The swimming crab slipped beneath the edge of the submerged camera stand.
entries.zh: 那只梭子蟹钻到了水下相机支架的边缘下面。

entries.en: The gardener picked a sword bean from the trellis beside the shed.
entries.zh: 园丁从棚屋旁的棚架上摘下了一根刀豆。

entries.en: I turned the sword fern's pot to reach the coin behind it.
entries.zh: 我转动肾蕨的花盆，去够它后面的硬币。

entries.en: The gardener left the clump of sword grass beside the stone wall.
entries.zh: 园丁把那丛剑状叶草留在了石墙旁。

entries.en: The sword lily leaned against the florist's empty display stand.
entries.zh: 那枝剑兰斜靠在花店的空展示架上。

entries.en: The factory sent a sample of the synthetic substance to an independent laboratory.
entries.zh: 工厂把那种合成物质的样本送到了独立实验室。
